metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins — adversarial review tooling that runs before code ships, stack-specific agents that build what it reviews, and deployment agents that check it arrived.

plugins.name: review-kit
plugins.description: Adversarial review tooling: attack a plan before it is built, rehearse a migration before it touches live data, and audit a running app against the accessibility tree and its own design system.

plugins.name: build-kit
plugins.description: Stack-specific implementation agents that carry their stack's traps: React on the client, Hono and Drizzle on the server, Playwright across both.

plugins.name: ship-kit
plugins.description: Agents whose subject is the deployment rather than the repository: prove a release actually reached production, and find out why an image that works locally does not work there.
